body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Audoivox presented its innovative remote control 'Acoustic Research Xsight' at the CES 2009, which offers simple on-remote setup plus an online application for customizing operation and expanding functionality. The Acoustic Research Xsight will be launched in this spring with two models.

The AR Xsight Touch(model: ARRX18G) controls up to 18 devices and features a 2.2-inch color LCD touch screen with slider bar, RF(433MHz radio frequency) capability for controlling devices that are hidden away and a rechargeable lithium-ion battery. The Acoustic Research Xsight Color(model: ARRX15G) controls up to 15 devices, has a 2.2-inch color LCD screen and runs on three AA batteries.

Both models feature blue backlighting, an ergonomic handset with an intuitive layout, quick navigation keys, built-in learning for most buttons, customizable soft keys and a cluster of keys dedicated to DVR/satellite/cable box control.
Suggested retail prices are 249.99(USD) for the AR Xsight Touch and 179.99(USD) for the AR Xsight Color.
